description: What changed in Georgia Commons since a cursor or a moment, oldest first: documents first loaded (`created`), new text (`text_changed`: a new bill version, minutes a body replaced), a bill's new actions and status (`status_changed`, with the actions and the status before and after), other record changes, and withdrawals. For tracking on a schedule: keep `next_since` and pass it as `since` next time, and nothing is missed or repeated. The clock is Georgia Commons' own (when it loaded or changed a document), never the document's date.

body.description: Only these issuing bodies, by id.

id.description: Only one document's events: its id or any written form (HB 340).

place.description: Only the documents of one place's own governments: a place in words or as an id (Marietta, city:savannah).

since.description: Where to start: the next_since of your last call, a date or an ISO 8601 date and time, or `now` (nothing yet, only a cursor to start from). Omit for the feed's first events.

name: get_changes

caught_up.description: False: more events are waiting after next_since.

next_since.description: Pass as `since` on the next call.

title: What changed since
